attachment.content_not_sent: The content of this file type is not sent to the model; only its name and size are
attachment.image_not_sent: The selected model cannot read images; only the name and size are sent
attachment.too_many: A message can carry at most {count} attachments
errors.positive_integer: Please enter an integer of 1 or more
link.generic_warning: This link leaves SCITL. Please make sure the URL is what you intended.
link.mailto_note: This will open your mail app.
link.special_char_body: You're about to visit a domain containing special characters. Please double-check the URL.
link.userinfo_body: This URL contains an @ sign. It may take you to a domain you didn't intend.
meta.name: English
select.models_empty: No models to choose from. You can add or show them under "API Providers" in Settings.
settings.config_unreadable: Couldn't read the settings file, so SCITL started with empty settings. Settings won't be saved until you fix the file and restart the app. ({error})
settings.general.export_caption: Writes all tasks and the general chat, together with their attachments, to Markdown files. Deleted tasks and messages are not included. Each export goes into a new folder.
settings.general.export_missing_attachme: Attachment files that could not be exported: {count}
settings.general.task_chat_prompt_captio: Put instructions here for operations on an individual task that the general chat can't do, such as adding, updating or deleting steps. They're appended after the system prompt above. Leave it empty to restore the default.
settings.general.task_opening_caption: Sent to the AI on your behalf when you add a task, so that it speaks first. It isn't shown in the chat, but it stays at the start of the conversation the AI sees. Leave it empty to restore the default.
settings.general.task_opening_label: First message of a new task
settings.heading: Settings
settings.http_warning: HTTPS is recommended. Plain HTTP is only allowed for loopback or private IP addresses (such as on your LAN), and the connection isn't encrypted. {secret} will also be sent in plain text.
settings.model.add_model_hint: Enter a model name to add
settings.model.none_registered: No models registered (registered models can be chosen in the chat)
settings.model.picker_all_registered: All fetched models ({count}) are already registered.
settings.model.tools_warning_tooltip: With a model that doesn't support tool calls, tasks and steps can no longer be updated
settings.model.visible_checkbox_label: Show {model} in the chat's model list
settings.provider.api_key_placeholder: Optional for local inference servers and the like
settings.provider.base_url_extra_path_an: Anthropic base URLs do not include /v1 (for example, https://api.anthropic.com).
settings.provider.base_url_extra_path_ge: Gemini base URLs do not include /v1beta (for example, https://generativelanguage.googleapis.com).
settings.provider.delete_provider_dialog: This deletes "{name}" along with its saved API key. This can't be undone.
settings.provider.unusable: This provider can't be used. Delete it, or switch to a model from another provider in the chat. ({error})
settings.tools.delete_server_dialog_mess: This unregisters "{id}" along with its saved secrets (environment variable and HTTP header values). This can't be undone.
settings.tools.env_hint: Environment variables (one per line, in {sample} format)
settings.tools.headers_hint: HTTP headers (one per line, in {sample} format)
settings.tools.id_invalid: Longer than {max} characters, or contains characters that aren't allowed
settings.tools.intro: Tool descriptions from registered servers are passed to the model as-is. Only register servers you trust.
settings.tools.kv_line_invalid: Line {line_no} ("{line}") is not in the {sample} format
settings.tools.max_rounds_caption: How many times the model can go back and forth to run tools. A single round may call several tools. Once they're used up, the model is called one more time to reply without tools.
settings.tools.max_rounds_label: Max tool call rounds per turn
settings.tools.not_exposable: Can't be enabled because its name can't be passed to the model
settings.tools.secret_helper: Values are saved to the credential store, not to the settings file.
settings.tools.server_id_hint: ID (up to {max} characters; letters, digits and underscores only)
settings.tools.stdio_warning: This transport runs the command with the same permissions as the app. Only register commands you trust.
settings.tools.timeout_caption: The total time tools can run within one turn. Waiting for the model's reply isn't included.
settings.tools.tools_enabled_only: No tools fetched yet. Only enabled tools are shown.
settings.tools.tools_none_fetched: No tools fetched yet. You can fetch them with "Fetch tool list".
task_chat.system_prompt: Through the conversation, ask what the user is trying to do, and help them make the task concrete and carry it out.
task_header.delete_dialog_message: This deletes "{title}" and hides its conversation.
turn_error.auth: The API key is missing or invalid, or lacks permission. Please check the API key in Settings.
turn_error.connection_failed: Could not communicate with the LLM provider. Please check that the server is running and your network connection.
turn_error.context_exceeded: The conversation may have exceeded the context limit. Setting this model's context length in the model list under "API Providers" in Settings lets old history be dropped automatically to reduce the token count.
turn_error.empty_response: The model returned an empty reply. Please try again.
turn_error.invalid_response: Could not interpret the reply from the LLM provider. Please check the server URL in Settings.
turn_error.no_model: No model selected. Please select a model below the chat input.
turn_error.no_provider: No LLM provider is set up. Please add one in Settings.
turn_error.provider: The LLM provider returned an error.
turn_error.provider_config: There's a problem with the provider settings. Please check Settings.
turn_error.rate_limit: Hit the API rate limit. Please wait a while and try again.
turn_error.refused: The model declined to respond to this request. Rephrase it or try again with a different model.
turn_error.response_timeout: The LLM provider didn't reply in time. You can change how long to wait with the reply timeout under "General" in Settings.
turn_error.settings_unreadable: Could not read the settings file. Please check the details in Settings.
turn_error.thinking_effort_unsupported: This model didn't accept the selected thinking effort. Please pick a different thinking effort below the chat input.
turn_error.thinking_unsupported: This model didn't accept a thinking effort. Please uncheck "Think" for this model in the model list under "API Providers" in Settings.
turn_error.tool_round_limit: Reached the maximum number of tool calls, so the reply was cut short. You can change it under "Tools/MCP" in Settings.
turn_error.tool_timeout: Tools ran out of time, so the reply was cut short. You can change the limit under "Tools/MCP" in Settings.
turn_error.tools_disabled: The tool calls the model asked for were not run, because this model is treated as not supporting tools. If it does support tools, check "Tool" for this model in the model list under "API Providers" in Settings.
